verdict.rationale: Numeral's docs say it provides native integrations for the platforms a business already runs on. Each integration calculates tax at checkout or invoice time and records completed transactions back to Numeral, and the pricing page lets you connect sales channels. However, the evidence never names a specific billing system, payment processor, or commerce platform, so coverage of the stack in the story cannot be confirmed. missing for 10: named supported integrations across billing, payment-processor and commerce categories, per-integration setup and maintenance docs, independent or hands-on corroboration that transactions sync without custom plumbing.
